from typing import Optional
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from lemma_sdk import FunctionContext


class CheckTicketUrgencyInput(BaseModel):
    ticket_id: str = Field(description="The ticket UUID to check urgency for.")
    urgency: str = Field(description="Urgency value from request-classifier output.")
    classification_status: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="Classification status for context.")


class CheckTicketUrgencyOutput(BaseModel):
    routing: str = Field(description="Routing signal: urgent/high skips ops coordination, normal/low proceeds.")
    ticket_id: str = Field(description="Echoed ticket_id for downstream nodes.")
    is_urgent: bool = Field(description="True if urgency is high or urgent.")


async def check_ticket_urgency(ctx: FunctionContext, data: CheckTicketUrgencyInput) -> CheckTicketUrgencyOutput:
    is_urgent = data.urgency in ("high", "urgent")
    return CheckTicketUrgencyOutput(
        routing=data.urgency,
        ticket_id=data.ticket_id,
        is_urgent=is_urgent,
    )
